IF state == On Hold:
    hold_reason MUST be set
    (Awaiting Caller | Awaiting Change | Awaiting Vendor)
caption: A state flip with no Hold Reason makes stuck tickets unreportable.

code:

caption: Resolution Code and Close Notes become mandatory only at Resolved.

subtitle: Letting the platform calculate Priority, instead of guessing.
